rules.statement: When a company's name is struck off, the property of the company generally vests in the State, but if the company held the property on trust for another person, the property may vest in that person.
rules.supporting_quote: When the name of the company is struck off, the property of the company generally vests in the State. However, as the petitioner claims, the question of whether he became the owner of the property should be decided at the trial.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 487(5) of the Companies Act No. 7 of 2007
